_comment: Pinned corrections applied by build-en-dicts.py after the WordNet pass: rows where the generator picked a rare synset (water → 小便) or where a gloss was corrected by hand. Keyed by library id, then headword; each entry replaces the fields it names.

water.def: the clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and seas

dog.def: a common four-legged animal kept as a pet or for work

song.def: a short piece of music with words that is sung

sorry.def: feeling regret or sympathy; said to apologise

training.def: the process of learning the skills needed for a job or activity

thus.def: as a result; in this way

horse.def: a large four-legged animal that people ride or use to pull loads

cake.def: a sweet baked food made from flour, eggs, sugar and butter

chicken.def: a farm bird kept for its eggs and meat; its meat as food

till.def: up to the time that; until

fifth.def: coming after the fourth; number five in a series

trip.def: a journey to a place and back

flight.def: a journey by aircraft; the act of flying

feed.def: to give food to a person or animal; to supply

shoes.def: coverings for the feet, usually with a firm sole

arrest.def: (of the police) to take someone into custody

ban.def: to forbid officially; an official prohibition

plate.def: a flat dish that food is served or eaten from

incident.def: an event, especially an unpleasant or unusual one

gang.def: a group of people who act together, often criminals

graduate.def: a person who has completed a degree or course; to complete one

appointment.def: an arrangement to meet at a set time; the naming of someone to a post

heading.def: a title at the top of a page or section

province.def: a main administrative division of a country

rolling.def: moving by turning over and over

founder.def: a person who starts an organisation or institution

formal.def: following official rules or conventions; not casual

gross.def: total, before anything is deducted; coarse or vulgar

bath.def: the act of washing the body in water; a tub for it

swimming.def: the activity of moving through water using the body

rail.def: a metal bar that trains run on; a bar to hold or lean on

repair.def: to fix something that is broken or damaged

steal.def: to take something that belongs to someone else without permission

congratulations.def: words said to praise someone for a success

translation.def: the rendering of words from one language into another

drove.def: past tense of drive; a herd of animals being moved together

column.def: a vertical line of text or numbers; a regular newspaper article; a tall pillar

constitutional.def: relating to or allowed by a constitution

shake.def: to move quickly up and down or from side to side

purple.def: the colour between red and blue

discrimination.def: unfair treatment of people because of their race, sex, age or the like

window.def: an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light and air

spread.def: to extend over a wider area; to open out

iron.def: a strong grey metal; a tool heated to smooth clothes

flat.def: level and smooth; a set of rooms for living in

developing.def: growing or becoming more advanced, said of a country or economy

hang.def: to fasten or be held from above so that the lower part is free

delivery.def: the bringing of goods to a place; the birth of a child

keep.def: to continue to have or hold; to stay in a state

company.def: a business organisation that sells goods or services

wild.def: living or growing in nature, not tamed; uncontrolled

accounting.def: the work of keeping and checking financial records

candy.def: a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate

framework.def: a basic structure or set of ideas that supports something

intelligent.def: able to learn and understand things quickly

lighting.def: the lights in a place, or the light they give

polish.def: to rub a surface until it shines; a substance used for this

sacrifice.def: to give up something valued for the sake of something more important

sole.def: only; the bottom part of a shoe or foot

alarm.def: a device that warns of danger or wakes you; sudden fear

butt.def: the buttocks; the end of a cigarette

satisfied.def: pleased because you got what you wanted

slip.def: to slide and lose your balance; a small piece of paper

spare.def: kept as an extra in case it is needed

auction.def: a public sale where goods go to the highest bidder

copper.def: a reddish-brown metal that conducts electricity well

mechanism.def: a system of parts working together; the way something works

homeless.def: having no home to live in

realise.def: to become aware of something; to make something happen

forgive.def: to stop being angry with someone who did something wrong

shelter.def: a place giving protection from bad weather or danger

deposit.def: money put into a bank account or paid as a first payment or guarantee; matter left by a natural process

gather.def: to come together or bring things together

neutral.def: not supporting either side; neither one thing nor the other

suspension.def: the act of stopping something for a time or barring someone from work or school; the springs of a vehicle

treasury.def: the government department in charge of public money; a place where money is kept

upgrade.def: to replace something with a better or newer version

coalition.def: a union of groups or parties that work together, especially in government

pension.def: money paid regularly to a person who has retired

developer.def: a person or company that builds software or property

cheque.def: a printed form ordering a bank to pay money from your account

analyze.def: to examine something in detail to understand it

swamp.def: an area of very wet, soft land

swan.def: a large white water bird with a long neck

tornado.def: a violent rotating column of wind
